name: countries
purpose: far pointer to the country array (0xBF-byte records, 0x603F bytes allocated)

name: players
purpose: far pointer to the player array (20-byte records, 0xEF24 bytes allocated)

name: manager_countries
purpose: far pointer to the manager array (0x195 bytes allocated): byte at +3*(0x80+m) is the country managed by manager m (1771:26B9 mode 2 stores it, 1771:2D15 reads it)

name: pool_indices
purpose: far pointer to the pool index array (0x3C2 bytes = word[481] allocated): A927[base..base+79] holds the 80 pool player numbers of the current manager, base = DS:6D18 + 2*manager

name: pool_base_table
purpose: the per-manager pool base: word[m] (m = 1..6) = 80*(m-1)+1, manager m's first pool index; word[0] is not read

name: side_base
purpose: two adjacent bytes, the pitch-slot base per engine team (every listing read is a byte: `mov al, byte ptr [di + 0x668]` at D5EF and DA01, seg_0791_21.asm, and likewise 1E63, 2029, 21CE...; never a word): 0668[t] + 1 .. +11 are team t's slots (team 0 owns 12..22, team 1 owns 1..11); D733's goal phase, D5C1, 8062 and 6337 all add it

name: sub_budgets
purpose: the substitution budget by DS:9A3D (not per team): DS:066B = 5 for a fixture of kind 1 (a friendly), DS:066C = 2 for every other kind; A4A1 copies the chosen byte into both sides' DS:9B3A (A605)

name: perf_delta
purpose: the performance delta per commentary template id, added by 0791:1E53 to the line's named player (38 goal +40, 39 own goal -50, 50 booked -20, 51 sent off -100, 65 challenge -10); nothing writes it at runtime

name: man_of_the_match
purpose: the man of the match's squad word, CAB0's winner (cleared per match by A4A1); drawn on the summary only when DS:9A3F is clear

name: match_form
purpose: morale snapshot per side and squad slot: dummy offset 0 then offsets 1..40 (20*side+slot); F1F6 saves and CB7D restores nonzero words; 7CC5 with nonzero flag writes min(32,s8(new live form)); substitutions swap matching bytes

name: form_delta
purpose: 65FE's per-goal form deltas: byte 0 = -1 (the side without the ball), byte 1 = +1 (the side of DS:830B); 6443 gives the scorer byte [7C39 != 0 ? 0 : 1]

name: quick_scorer_slots
purpose: the goal-scorer slot table: a dummy base at 0xA6B plus 30 entries (values 2..11, weighted), read as the byte at 0xA6B + rand(30)

name: pitch_records
purpose: the pitch record array: record k at 0x80E8+0x16*k, the 22 on-pitch slots 1..22 (0x80FE..0x82E1); the byte table DS:883[k] maps 9564's loop index to a record number

name: ball_record
purpose: the ball record: position +0/+1, velocities +6/+8 (DS:82FC/82FE), timer +0xA (DS:8300)

name: referee_record
purpose: the referee sprite record 9119 moves every watched tick (row +0, column +1, glyph +4, target +6/+7)

name: rng_word_ptr
purpose: far pointer to the RNG word every 214B:06B1 / 06D0 / 06FA draw steps (214B:0688); 214B:206A sets it to DS:7B62

name: rng_word
purpose: the RNG word: := country by 1771:97CC, := hour*256 + minute by 23E4:11D7 (year 0 only, through 1771:6730), stepped by 214B:0688 as w * 0x7ABD + 0x1B0F

name: initial_letters
purpose: Pascal string of the 21 letters a new initial is drawn from (1771:0000): ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTVW

name: young_age_base
purpose: 000E:54F0's young limit and override base by (+7 == 0): 17, 20 (young is +1 < this + 4; override +1 = this + rand(3))

name: managed_age_base
purpose: 000E:54F0's age base by (+7 == 0): 25, 28 (+1 = this + rand(6) - rand(6))

name: retire_age_limit
purpose: 1771:7F40's age limit by (+7 == 0): 30, 33 (retires above it with caps 0)

name: new_player_age_base
purpose: make_player's age base by (+7 == 0): 28, 31 (+1 = this - rand(7) + rand(7))

name: pool_age_base
purpose: 1771:98C4's age base for the pool copies of the squad slots by (+7 == 0): 17, 20 (+1 = this + rand(3))

name: fitness_redraw_base
purpose: 3558's base B selected by unsigned age>peak_age+4; managed and unmanaged draws around B

name: country_order_ptr
purpose: far pointer to the country order 1771:5EE1 sorts and 1771:63A4 ranks by: DS:9BFD (world, 128) or DS:9C7E (four continents of 32)

name: fitness_recovery_cap
purpose: 3651 upper fitness cap selected by unsigned age>peak_age+3; lower clamp to 1 bypasses this table

name: fixture_not_friendly
purpose: A4A1 sets it to 0 when the fixture's byte +2 is 1 (a friendly) and to 1 otherwise (A547-A554); it indexes DS:066B and, nonzero, lets the quick engine's D733 call D5C1 (the only quick foul path)

name: substitutions_left
purpose: per side (0 or 1, as DS:9B34) the substitutions left in this match: A4A1 sets both from DS:066B[DS:9A3D] (A605); 0791:C5DC decrements the side's byte (C7DC, no test of zero); the action replay's restore 0F0B writes the word DS:9B38 into DS:9B3A; 8062, C88D, 7D56 and the bench screen (E544, E688, E6A2) test it

name: match_stats
purpose: the match statistics, byte side*10 + k for k = 0..9, cleared by A4A1 (A4EF); k = 6 the fouls (8206), 7 the bookings (798D), 8 the sendings off (7B24), 9 the injuries (7D56); 7A43 reads k = 8 and 9; k = 0..5 are shown on the statistics screen and not read for this row

name: added_time
purpose: the added minutes still to play: A4A1 zeroes it (A626); 798D, 7B77 and 7D56 add 1 each while it is below 5; 970C counts it down only after DS:831B reached 0, so the remaining added time is at most 5 at any moment and, when no event falls after the added minutes begin, the match runs min(5, events) minutes past 90; the first half does not consult it

name: foul_draw_table
purpose: bytes 1..255 are rand(16) - 1 (0..15), filled by 0791:2648 at the match set-up; 261A returns the byte at DS:8437 and advances it; 7EEF reads two per foul (draw1 < 4, draw2 == 1); byte 0 is unused

name: foul_draw_index
purpose: the index into DS:foul_draw_table 261A reads and advances (255 wraps to 1); 2648 sets it to DS:9B36 (the second side's country number)

name: start_posts
purpose: the start post (x, y; signed bytes) per position code, in the team's own frame; read by 0791:419C

name: group_code_table
purpose: the group code g by [2 * (+6 > 4) + flag] = 3, 2, 2, 1 (0791:42CB); T52: 42CB's line class by 2 * (position > 4) + f: 3, 2, 2, 1; the keeper returns class 4 without indexing this four-byte table

name: home_depth_by_position
purpose: a depth offset per position code, read by 0791:4438 (added to the post's y)

name: kickoff_depth_by_position
purpose: the kick-off depth per position code: 0791:69BD adds it to the post's y

name: defend_depth_table
purpose: the defending depth limit DS:07CB[e5 * 8 + e6 * 4 + g] (g 1..4); T52: the target row offset of a slot off the ball's side by 8 * element 5 + 4 * element 6 + class (class 1..3; read in 4B64 and 4649): 0E 00 00 00 | 00 0F 0A 02 | 00 0A 05 00 | 00 2D 19 05

name: attack_depth_table
purpose: the attacking depth limit DS:07DB[e7 * 4 + g] (g 1..4); T52: the target row offset of a slot on the ball's side by 4 * element 7 + class (4B64, 4532): 00 3C 2D 19 | 00 3C 32 23

name: label_class_by_position
purpose: the class per position code for the formation label: 0 keeper, 1 codes 1..4, 2 codes 5..11, 3 codes 12 and 13 (1771:0E6C)

name: line_by_position
purpose: the quick engine's line per position code: 0 keeper, 1 defence, 2 midfield, 3 attack, 4 half defence half midfield, 5 half midfield half attack (1771:0BC4)

name: base_height
purpose: a player's base height in inches per club position; 1771:2FAD adds DS:0E54[number mod 12]

name: foot_rows
purpose: foot index (0 left, 1 right) per club position, two rows of 14; 1771:3088 selects the row by DS:0E7C[number mod 3]

name: mark_pair_table
purpose: the 14 position glyphs (G S C b B D 80 m M F w W 9B $), then four rows of 14 bytes (priority 1..4) read by 1771:3E2F: indexed by the opposing position, the value is the position code of the own player that marks him

name: bench_roles
purpose: per outgoing position code a row of 8 bytes: the count and the club positions accepted as substitute (0791:AAE8)

name: fixtures
purpose: far pointer to the fixture list: 8-byte records, number n at +8n-8; 1..2400 fixtures, 2401..2408 play-off aggregates, 0xFF sentinel at 2409 (0x4B48 bytes allocated)

name: country_fixture_lists
purpose: far pointer to the per-country lists of 36 fixture numbers (0x48 bytes each, 0x2448 allocated), newest last

name: group_tables
purpose: far pointer to the group tables (0x1C00 bytes): slot at +class*0xE00 + table*0x700 + continent*0x1C0 + group*0x38 + slot*8 - 0x200; slot = country word, W, D, L, GF, GA, points

name: result_kinds
purpose: the set of fixture kinds {3, 4, 7, 8..203} (F019); 1771:5A03 tests it

name: decider_kinds
purpose: the set of fixture kinds {4, 8..203} for which a drawn match goes on (extra time in a silent result, the shoot-out gate DS:7C36); bytes 10 FF x24 0F 00 x6

name: start_stage
purpose: the stage a new game starts in by class (start year mod 4 == 2): 2, 5

name: class_first_fixture
purpose: first fixture number of class 0 (stages 2-4) and class 1 (stages 5-8): 1, 1361

name: draw_slot_permutations
purpose: four rows of the slot permutation a draw picks at random: (1 2 3 4) (2 3 4 1) (3 4 2 1) (4 1 2 3)

name: round_pair_table
purpose: eleven rows (g + continent = 2..12) of 12 ordered pairs of slots, the double round robin of a group of 4 by round

name: friendly_partner_group
purpose: 8 groups x 6 rounds: the group whose slot-a teams the group plays friendlies against (0 = none)

name: round_robin_pairs
purpose: the six pairs (1,2) (3,4) (1,3) (2,4) (1,4) (2,3) of a single round robin of a group of 4

name: pass_distance_base
purpose: the pass target distance base 3111 adds a draw to: [0] = 2 (short, element 3 clear), [1] = 0x18 (long, element 3 set)
